name: Jester
personality: An erratic, unstable gladiator who hides behind clown makeup and feeds on his opponents' fear.
story: Jester is a masked gladiator in Bertrand's Army who enjoys terrifying crowds and values the entertainment Bertrand provides. Recruiting him takes Support 3, Renown 6-10 depending on route, and a three-quest chain: Bale Lacerators (Dada Plains), Gorpse-Gaol Dunanzao (Fort Theed), and Underworld Wanderers (Whispering Rock, deadline 27/11).

personalSkill.name: Blink of an Eye
personalSkill.effect: Grants Def +3 until the unit's next phase after using Swap. Lv 20: Flickering Edge (Atk +3 during combat after evading); Lv 35: Flickering Edge+ (Atk +5).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: B. KeenGamer: B (strong Spd, but costly recruitment and positioning-dependent).

why: Support 3 ties with Cai, Theodora, Leda, but Renown 6 here is the earliest.

build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class (Hunter; Ch 8), then Rogue at Lv 20 (Bow C, Sword C). Recruited in Ch 10+ he joins at about Lv 25 as a Myrmidon with a Levin Sword instead. Ranger in Part II Ch 1 (Lv 35, Bow B, Sword B; beat Oko in Part I). Master In Shadow (Avo +10 after a kill), then Countershot. Flickering Edge rewards dodging. Teach Secrets still copies Dietrich's sword arts. Carry a Mini Bow for range-1 bow counters.

guide.summary: Evasive bow and sword skirmisher with 60 Spd growth. Rogue through Part I, Ranger from Part II Ch 1 (Oko unlocks it); dodge to fuel Flickering Edge and chain kills for In Shadow.

watch: Dodger: extra ≤ 3. Part II Silver Sword 4 + Phantom Ring 3 = 7. Part III Iron Sword +4 4 + 3 = 7, Cleansing Blade +2 3 + 3 = 6, Da Mina Bow +2 6 + 3 = 9; no Spd item, so a double that slips goes back to the sword.
No mask: the Charm Mask (5) breaks the budget. If he stops doubling with the bow, switch to the sword before dropping the ring.
Part II: Ch 12 kit (Cleansing Blade, Silver Sword, Da Mina Bow, Phantom Ring, Concoction) plus the Cleansing Blade +1 in Ch 2 is 6/6.
